hypothesis: An online, locally trained surprise/reliability-dependent write gate may form a more useful predictive summary than a fully trained conventional single-state recurrent predictor at equal storage under observed sensor-regime changes.
hypothesis_discriminator: The candidate must beat all fully informed, fully fitted controls under equal one-scalar online-state accounting; observed sensor cue is provided to EVERY algorithm.
negative_custody: Q15 failed against trained Bayesian filter; F_A/F_B DEV exposed; original source global reset custody Q14 NO-GO. Neither reused.

generator.mode: binary latent z_t with hazard, public observed cue c_t in {-1,+1}, public binary observation x_t in {-1,+1}; z only training/validation label

family_algorithms.name: E_regime
family_algorithms.algorithm: a Markov sensor-reliability regime switches at probability 0.11 each step; public c exposes the regime with 0.09 independent observation error; observation x flips z with probability 0.06 if reliable and 0.42 otherwise; z flips with hazard 0.08

family_algorithms.name: F_burst
family_algorithms.algorithm: sensor reliability follows burst runs: after a randomly drawn countdown expires initiate distraction burst of 2-5 samples; c reports whether currently in distraction exactly, x flips z with probability 0.41 inside bursts and 0.14 outside; z flips with hazard 0.13

candidate.name: SURPRISE_RELIABILITY_WRITE
candidate.trained: finite-difference Adam of full train binary log-loss

recurrent.name: TRAINED_TANH_RNN
recurrent.trained: same finite-difference Adam of full train binary log-loss

bayes.name: TRAINED_CUE_BAYES
bayes.equation: fit transition hazard and P(x mismatch z | c=+1/-1) by training-label MLE, online 1-scalar exact binary posterior with observed cue
bayes.trained: complete train cohort MLE; no true hidden generator probabilities provided

symbolic.name: TRAINED_DECAYED_CUE_COUNT
symbolic.trained: finite-difference Adam of full train binary log-loss

current.name: TRAINED_CURRENT_CUE
current.trained: finite-difference Adam of full train binary log-loss

optimizer.validation_checkpoint: epoch 18 only, choose lowest DEV across exactly two restarts; never retune on DEV
optimizer.nll: per-step Bernoulli log-loss in nats, numerically stable
optimizer.measured_cost: per-model training process-time incl all restarts, validation inference process-time, tracemalloc peak; report parameter and memory state counts; CPU comparisons only on same OS
